PLAN "12-Week Strength+Hypertrophy Programme with Nutrition Support, General Health Cardio, Phase 2 Push Intensity, HIIT Day, Plyometric/Power Day, Phase 3 1RM Test, and Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build 12-week structured strength and hypertrophy progression with nutrition support, cardio, HIIT, plyometrics, and end-phase 1RM testing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Week1 - Foundation A":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Week1 - Foundation B":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Week1 - Foundation C":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x5..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Sunday cardio 30m "Week1 - General Health Cardio A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main cardio:
          running 20 minutes
          walking 5 minutes
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Week2 - Foundation A Continuation":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Week2 - Foundation B Continuation":
        warmup:
          row_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Week2 - Foundation C Continuation":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x5..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Sunday cardio 30m "Week2 - General Health Cardio B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main cardio:
          cycling 20 minutes
          walking 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      Day pattern similar to Weeks 1-2 with progressive load; maintain variations
    WEEK 4:
      Deload week: reduce sets/reps by ~30%, maintain movement quality
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Week5 - Progression A (Push Intensity Up)":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Week5 - Progression B":
        warmup:
          row_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push-up_variant 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          front_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Week5 - Progression C":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_extension 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          curl_variation 3x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes

          walking 5 minutes
        main cardio:
          cycling 20 minutes
          walking 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes

        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes

          dynamic_mobility 5 minutes
        main power:
          plyometric_box_jump 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          jump_squat 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes

        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:

          bent_over_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes

        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main cardio:
          rowing 20 minutes
          walking 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 10-12:
      1RM_test planning and progression review; optional deload and maintenance blocks
  NUTRITION PLAN
    GOAL_SUPPORT
      description "Support hypertrophy with estimated energy surplus, adequate protein, and balanced macros. Adjust for individual needs."
      daily_energy_target_note "Initial target: approximate 250–500 kcal surplus above maintenance. Monitor weight and adjust by 150–250 kcal every 2–3 weeks as needed."

      daily_target_g 130
      notes "Aim for 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight per day. Distribute protein across 3–6 meals; include 0.4–0.6 g/kg per meal when possible."

      daily_target_g 300
      notes "Fuel training sessions; emphasize complex carbs around workouts (pre- and post-workout). Adjust up/down based on appetite and progress."
    FATS
      daily_target_g 70
      notes "Include essential fats; balance Omega-3 and Omega-6 intake."
    MEAL_TIMING
      guidelines [
        "Protein every 3–4 hours to support muscle protein synthesis.",
        "Pre-workout: 1–2 hours before training, include 20–40 g protein and 30–60 g carbohydrates.",
        "Post-workout: within 1–2 hours, 0.25–0.4 g/kg carbohydrate and 0.25–0.4 g/kg protein."
      ]
    HYDRATION
      daily_goal_liters 2.5
      notes "Adjust for sweat loss; include electrolytes on training days if needed."
    SUPPLEMENTATION
      items [
        "Creatine monohydrate 3–5 g daily (consistent dosing recommended).",
        "Vitamin D3 1000–2000 IU daily if deficient or insufficient sun exposure.",
        "Consider a multivitamin if diet variety is limited."
      ]
    WEEKLY_PLAN
      note [
        "Track weekly body weight and performance. If weight gain exceeds 0.25–0.5 kg/week, reduce surplus by ~100–150 kcal.",
        "If performance stalls, consider small carbohydrate bump around training days or slight volume adjustment."
      ]
    IMPLEMENTATION
      instructions [
        "Integrate nutrition plan with Phase progression. Reassess nutrition targets at Phase boundaries (weeks 4, 8, 12) based on goals and progress.",
        "Maintain consistent protein intake across meals; hydrate around workouts."
      ]
    GENERAL_HEALTH_CARDIO
      note [
        "Include 2–3 general health cardio sessions per week, 20–40 minutes each, at conversational intensity (RPE 4–6).",
        "Spread across non-consecutive days to support recovery."
      ]
    PLYOMETRIC_POWER_DAY
      note [
        "In Phase 2, place a dedicated plyometric/power day on weeks with lower squat/deadlift emphasis if needed.",
        "Maintain technique focus; land softly; scale volume to avoid excessive fatigue."
      ]
    1RM_TEST_PLAN
      test_name "End of Phase 3 1RM Test"
      schedule_note "Plan to conduct after Week 12 (end of Phase 3). Ensure 48–72 hours recovery since last heavy lifting."
      protocol [
        "Warm-up: 5–10 minutes light cardio + dynamic mobility for key lifts (hip hinge, hinge/row, chest, overhead).",
        "SRT phase: work up to a hard single per exercise with 1–2 warm reps (e.g., 5-3-2-1 ramping to top single).",
        "Core lifts for 1RM: Bench Press, Squat, Deadlift, Overhead Press, Bent Over Row.",
        "Rest: 3–5 minutes between attempts; if initial attempt fails, adjust downward and retry once.",

        "Enter 1RM results in plan data with estimated 1RM calculation formula (e.g., E1RM = weight x (1 + reps/30)).",
        "Safety: use spotters for bench, rack height checked, technique prioritized; stop if form breaks."
      ]
